key_findings: Exosomes from oxaliplatin-treated SGCs increased ROS-positive DRG neurons, upregulated ASIC3 and TRPV1, and induced mechanical hypersensitivity with DRG TRPV1 upregulation in naive mice.
25 up- and 120 downregulated miRNAs were found in the exosomes; 27 pain-related miRNAs including miR-324-3p, miR-181a-5p, miR-122-5p were identified in silico.
